workflow: An optimizing execution engine keeps top-of-stack values in a fast cache instead of canonical stack storage.
Execution takes a side exit from optimized code to a fallback path.
The exit updates cache metadata but fails to write cached values back to canonical stack storage.
The fallback path interprets stale or missing stack state as valid and dereferences an invalid value, terminating the process.
summary: Unsynchronized cached stack state during optimized-code side exit
decision_reason: This is distinct from the existing clusters: the failure is specifically an optimized-to-fallback side exit that omits flushing cached stack values, rather than stale tracing across a boundary or invalidated specialized code continuing execution.
